notes: ICP system. Sister Keeprite shares styles 1-5 with identical examples and positions, but Keeprite lists no style 6, so no verbatim reuse is claimed in either direction. Style 2 is the same system as style 1 with a printed MFG date on the tag. HELD GAPS — style 4 (8-digit numeric, year = 1st digit, week = 2nd-3rd digits): the format example 30512345 has no stated decode and its year-digit mapping is chart-image-only; styles 5 (letter-digit-letter prefix, year = 3rd letter) and 6 (two-letter prefix, year = 2nd letter): the page shows only placeholders Z3Zxxxxx / ZZxxxxx and the year-letter charts are image-only, and the xxxxx tail shapes are undocumented. None of styles 4-6 is shipped rather than guessed.

styles.notes: Year is 2nd-3rd digits, week is 4th-5th digits. Week decode for the example is 16.

styles.era: Letter followed by 9 digits, with printed MFG date on tag
styles.notes: Page states this serial is identical in system to style 1; the printed MFG date 2/92 corroborates year 1992 and week 06. Pattern and positions duplicate style 1, so this style never wins first-match, but its decode is identical.

styles.era: 10-character format, year-week in first four digits
styles.notes: Year is 1st-2nd digits, week is 3rd-4th digits. Week decode for the example is 14.
